description: Get quotes for multi-hop routes across supported EVM chains. Resolves optimal path internally -- e.g., ETH on Base to USDC on Arbitrum may route through WBTC. Returns the full route as ordered hops with per-hop detail. Note: For Cosmos destinations (Persistence, Cosmos Hub), use xprt_farm_boost or bridge_get_quote with Squid Router.

amount.description: Amount in human-readable units (e.g. '100' for 100 USDC)

fromChain.description: Source chain (e.g. 'base', 'ethereum', or chain ID like '8453')

fromToken.description: Token to send -- symbol (e.g. 'USDC', 'ETH') or contract address (0x...)

optimize.description: Optimize for lowest cost or fastest delivery

toToken.description: Token to receive -- symbol (e.g. 'USDC', 'ETH') or contract address (0x...)

name: bridge_quote_multi
